segments.text: Claire meets Valerie, a former coworker she hasn’t seen in fifteen years. Claire left her job to raise a family, while Valerie stayed at the company. At first, Claire thinks Valerie is jealous of her marriage and children.

segments.text: Meanwhile, Jay reluctantly agrees to play racquetball with Cameron. He’s uncomfortable about sharing a locker room with a gay man and keeps imagining that Cameron will look at him differently.

segments.text: While they’re changing, their bare backsides accidentally touch. Cameron casually calls it a “moon landing,” but Jay can’t stop thinking about it and loses their first game. He demands a rematch and wins.
